program:
app "Quiz" brain ocean
table answer q num 1..5, ok bool
state qi num = 1
let ques(n num) = if(n = 1, "Capital of Pakistan?", if(n = 2, "How many continents are there?", if(n = 3, "Largest planet?", if(n = 4, "Boiling point of water in C?", "Fastest land animal?"))))
let oa(n num) = if(n = 1, "Karachi", if(n = 2, "7", if(n = 3, "Mars", if(n = 4, "90", "Lion"))))
let ob(n num) = if(n = 1, "Islamabad", if(n = 2, "5", if(n = 3, "Jupiter", if(n = 4, "120", "Cheetah"))))
let oc(n num) = if(n = 1, "Lahore", if(n = 2, "6", if(n = 3, "Saturn", if(n = 4, "100", "Horse"))))
let right(n num) = if(n = 1, 2, if(n = 2, 1, if(n = 3, 2, if(n = 4, 3, 2))))
let answered = count(answer where q = qi) > 0
if qi > 5
  stat count(answer where ok = yes), "score out of 5"
  button "Restart" tap remove all answer then set qi = 1
else
  "Question" qi "of 5" faint
  text ques(qi) head
  button oa(qi) tap add answer q = qi, ok = right(qi) = 1
  button ob(qi) tap add answer q = qi, ok = right(qi) = 2
  button oc(qi) tap add answer q = qi, ok = right(qi) = 3
  if answered
    if(last(answer.ok), "Correct", "Wrong") bold color if(last(answer.ok), good, bad)
    button "Next" tap set qi = qi + 1
describe:
Quiz, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- answer: q: number, 1 to 5; ok: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- answered is how many answer entries where q is qi is more than 0.
Remembers while you use it: qi, starting at 1.
Shows:
- if qi is more than 5:
  - a big number: how many answer entries where ok is yes, labelled "score out of 5".
  - a button "Restart"; a tap removes all answer entries, with one undo, then sets qi to 1.
- otherwise:
  - text: "Question", qi, "of 5".
  - text: "Capital of Pakistan?" when qi is 1, otherwise "How many continents are there?" when qi is 2, otherwise "Largest planet?" when qi is 3, otherwise "Boiling point of water in C?" when qi is 4, otherwise "Fastest land animal?".
  - a button "Karachi" when qi is 1, otherwise "7" when qi is 2, otherwise "Mars" when qi is 3, otherwise "90" when qi is 4, otherwise "Lion"; a tap adds a answer with q set to qi, ok set to 2 when qi is 1, otherwise 1 when qi is 2, otherwise 2 when qi is 3, otherwise 3 when qi is 4, otherwise 2 is 1.
  - a button "Islamabad" when qi is 1, otherwise "5" when qi is 2, otherwise "Jupiter" when qi is 3, otherwise "120" when qi is 4, otherwise "Cheetah"; a tap adds a answer with q set to qi, ok set to 2 when qi is 1, otherwise 1 when qi is 2, otherwise 2 when qi is 3, otherwise 3 when qi is 4, otherwise 2 is 2.
  - a button "Lahore" when qi is 1, otherwise "6" when qi is 2, otherwise "Saturn" when qi is 3, otherwise "100" when qi is 4, otherwise "Horse"; a tap adds a answer with q set to qi, ok set to 2 when qi is 1, otherwise 1 when qi is 2, otherwise 2 when qi is 3, otherwise 3 when qi is 4, otherwise 2 is 3.
  - if answered:
    - text: "Correct" when the latest ok of answer, otherwise "Wrong".
    - a button "Next"; a tap sets qi to qi plus 1.
